modification_description: The agent requests three additions to the synthesis: (1) include household-wide functioning goals (quiet hours, shared chores, predictable shutdown times) not just the teen's individual metrics; (2) pair gaming limits with academic support scaffolding (homework planning, tutoring, anxiety support) to address root causes of school decline rather than only restricting time; (3) implement staged, gradual thresholds with measurable check-ins rather than abrupt hard limits to prevent all-or-nothing backlash and preserve trust.
